speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand the cause of your finger swelling and pain, can you tell me if you have had any recent injuries, insect bites, or contact with irritants to that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail. Can you tell me if the finger is deformed or if you are unable to fully straighten or bend it?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
You have a classic presentation of a "Jammed Finger." The inability to flex the distal joint and the finger remaining extended at rest strongly suggests an avulsion fracture or tendon avulsion, often called a Mallet Finger or Baseball Finger.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
